events.title: Emperor Guangwu makes Luoyang the capital of the Eastern Han
events.description: Emperor Guangwu of Han, who had risen against Wang Mang's Xin dynasty and restored the Han, declared Luoyang the capital of the Eastern Han dynasty. The Eastern Han, named after the location of its capital, lasted until 220.

events.title: The usurper Phocas has the deposed emperor Maurice executed
events.description: Phocas, leader of the army mutiny that had overthrown Emperor Maurice, had Maurice's five sons executed and then Maurice himself. The murder gave the Sasanian king Khosrow II a pretext for a long war that exhausted both empires.

events.title: Pope Urban II preaches the First Crusade at Clermont
events.description: Closing the Council of Clermont, Urban II urged Western knights to aid Byzantium and free Jerusalem. The response was overwhelming, and crusaders took Jerusalem in 1099.
events.html: Closing the Council of Clermont, Urban II urged Western knights to aid Byzantium and free Jerusalem. The response was overwhelming, and crusaders took Jerusalem in 1099.

events.title: The Song defeat the Jin fleet at the Battle of Caishi
events.description: The naval battle at Caishi on the Yangtze ended in a decisive Song victory, aided by gunpowder bombs, over the fleet of the Jin emperor Wanyan Liang. The defeat led to his murder by his own officers.
events.html: The naval battle at Caishi on the Yangtze ended in a decisive Song victory, aided by gunpowder bombs, over the fleet of the Jin emperor Wanyan Liang. The defeat led to his murder by his own officers.

events.title: Barquq deposes Sultan al-Salih Hajji and takes the Mamluk throne
events.description: Barquq, a Circassian who had come to Egypt as a slave, deposed Sultan al-Salih Hajji, the last of the Bahri Mamluks, who had ruled Egypt since 1250. His accession began the rule of the Burji Mamluks, which lasted until 1517.

events.title: Anders Celsius is born in Uppsala
events.description: The Swedish astronomer Anders Celsius was born. In 1742 he proposed a 100-degree temperature scale, originally with 0 for boiling water; it was later inverted to become the Celsius scale.

events.title: Custer's troops attack Black Kettle's camp on the Washita
events.description: The 7th Cavalry under George Armstrong Custer attacked a Cheyenne village on the Washita River, killing Black Kettle and many women and children. The army called it a battle; many historians call it a massacre.

events.title: Mayor Moscone and Harvey Milk are shot in San Francisco
events.description: Former supervisor Dan White shot dead Mayor George Moscone and Supervisor Harvey Milk at City Hall. Milk had been one of the first openly gay elected officials in the United States.
